notes.title: Development Update No. 001
notes.content:
Hello Survivors,

yes Frozen Below: Arctic Expedition started a few weeks ago and we were already able to draw a lot of feedback out of it. We pushed our first patch recently, but of course we already started to extend the content further.

So here are some small insights from the last weeks we were working on Frozen Below and what to expect in the future.

[h2]Extended Areas[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44932442/c500d30e590a9ef00e0868ccdf30277bb77df80c.jpg[/img]
We've made significant progress in extending the level design for our horror game set in the frozen arctic. New areas have been added, further passes from the research station and treacherous ice caves to enhance exploration and tension. Atmospheric elements like dynamic weather changes and haunting soundscapes will deepen the immersive experience. Our goal is to heighten player suspense and engagement as they navigate through this chilling environment.

[h2]The Inventory[/h2]
While testing the game ourself, we had a much bigger set of items for our player. With bandages, injections, water, alcohol, fuel and some more, it was quite a mess. So we decided to reduce the amount of items further, to help the player enjoy the pure gameplay instead of navigating to much through his backpack.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44932442/d3ee4fff34168253efa7db88865d9dc06104e689.jpg[/img]
With the new update, we plan to simplify it way further by adding a radial menu.
This will help to focus on the stuff we have, certain elements like keys or puzzle items will display separately and will make use of a simple interaction widget itself.

[h2]Enemy AI[/h2]
While you were mostly escaping the enemy at this point, you didn't had a chance to interact with it directly. This will change. Right now we are already fine tuning our AI to be quite responsive to sound, search for his pray and hunt you down. But you will also be able to distract him with sounds, but we will demonstrate it further with an upcoming dev log soon.

Stay tuned for more updates as we continue to refine the gameplay experience!
If you have any ideas or feedback, don't forget to join our [url=https://discord.gg/GhxtxZfk][b]discord[/b][/url] and help us grow the game.

notes.title: Freezing Update 1.6
notes.content:
Hello Survivors,
this patch resolves critical bugs and some suggested improvement reported by the community. Thank you for your continued feedback and support.

[b]Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*] Added a "locked" notification on doors.
[*] Improved the range to pickup items.
[*] Improved the performance slightly.
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed the blur effect when being hurt, which caused a high intensity lens flare.
[*] Fixed brigthness by default, so that it is easier to see.
[*] Fixed the loudness of the master volume.
[*] Fixed some unneeded loading screens.
[*] Fixed some coliders.
[/list]

Thanks for all your feedback! We're dedicated to improving the game experience and welcome your thoughts on this update.

notes.title: It's getting cold outside
notes.content:
Dear Explorer,

one year ago we started an Expedition which will finally become the coldest day of the year. With Frozen Below: Arctic Expedition we are preparing our first steps into the horror genre and invite all players to explore the arctic deadly environment and what is deep under the ice.

But I am sure you want to know a bit more about it, so let's dive deeper.

[b]What is the story of Frozen Below: Arctic Expedition?[/b]
Of course we don't to spoiler to much of it, but it seems you start unplanned as survivor of a crashed airplane. And luckily some snow camp is close by, but something seems odd ... the less you know, the better for yourself!

[b]What are the key features of the game?[/b]
It will be mainly a horror escape game, where you need to pass some puzzles and find the right way to escape, what is hopefully harder then you think, especially without compass, map or way points ... but that's not all what makes it hard to survive, one of the deadliest enemies will be the frozen temperature, which could kill you pretty fast if you don't pay attention to it ... maybe even something else lures into the frozen darkness.

Other then that, the player needs a good sense of exploration skills, pathfinding and platforming to stay alive. Use some additional tools to make it a bit easier, but be aware that they not rescue you from everything.

[b]What is the estimated playtime right now?[/b]
At this point we aim about two to three hours for the first final chapter, but it depends a bit on how much the community is willing to help us grow it.

[b]When will early access start?[/b]
We plan to make the first few minutes playable in Q1 2024 and hope people will stick with us to see what is coming next.

[b]So what is the status of the game?[/b]
We are quite far and started building certain areas to a more complex scenario, extend some environment and do popper adjustments of different features. To say it in numbers ...
- Level design = 80%
- Features = 90%
- AI = 60%
- Story = 60%

[b]When will you release the full game?[/b]
We plan on doing a full fledged gold release this October. Quite in Time for halloween and the upcoming winter time.

If you have any further questions or suggestions, feel free to discuss them with us on our [url=https://discord.gg/teUzWAkaPp]discord server[/url].
